work.summary: Desktop and network IT support specialist for Hamilton Library desktop systems and patron loaner equipment.
highlights: Troubleshoot, repair, and maintain desktop PC hardware, software, and peripheral systems for library staff and patrons.
Configure, deploy, and support loaner devices—including laptops and iPads—assisting students with hardware setups and application troubleshooting.
Diagnose and resolve local area network (LAN) and connectivity issues to ensure reliable desktop network access.

work.summary: Provided hands-on hardware, software, and network infrastructure support across campus facilities and dormitories.
highlights: Configured, deployed, and mounted outdoor wireless access points across campus buildings and dormitories to expand network coverage.
Executed physical network infrastructure installations, including pulling and terminating cabling and fiber lines.
Performed technical maintenance, system installations, and network troubleshooting for campus-wide IT systems.
